description.en: Flexible bank credit for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, farm-household needs, maintenance of farm assets, and agriculture or allied activities such as dairy and fisheries.

benefit_summary.en: The bank fixes the credit limit. Government interest support and a prompt-repayment incentive can reduce the effective rate on eligible short-term KCC credit; current limits and security requirements depend on the loan and lender.

eligibility_summary.en: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and eligible farmer Self Help Groups or Joint Liability Groups may apply. The lending bank makes the final credit decision.

name.en: Landholding proof certified by revenue authorities

notes.en: The bank may use different evidence for tenants, lessees, sharecroppers, SHGs, or JLGs.

instruction.en: Choose a participating bank and obtain its current KCC application.
Submit the form and supporting documents online or at the bank branch.
Ask the bank to explain the sanctioned limit, interest, security, repayment schedule, and applicable subsidy before accepting.

citation.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare via myScheme
